diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~61% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (5 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.259), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single FT_rf' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.8383. Series context: trend strength 0.8754 and seasonal strength 0.4849; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.259); 12 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 6.75.
